Subjects in the WL condition endorsed significantly less depressive symptomatology on the CDS whxle the reduction reported on the CDI was nonsignificant. dxgive.evidence_source: [page/13/Text/3] At pretesting, all of the subjects had scores in excess of 13 on the CDI.
dxgive.warning: The text mentions symptom cutoffs (CDI > 13, CDRS-R > 40) but does not state that participants met formal diagnostic criteria for a depressive disorder or that a diagnostic interview was required for inclusion.
